authority.instruction: I'd like To expand this unit of work to include XLSX and PPTX documents - assume we're already capable of text and web ingestion by both the ingest command and through our tool chain.
authority.scope_effect: Expand planned document support in INGEST and TOOLS-DOC; existing text/web behavior is assumed and preserved, not newly validated; format defaults remain proposed; no product construction or council authority inferred.

preserved_existing_capabilities: text ingestion via command and tool chain
web ingestion via command and tool chain
assumption_limit: Existing text/web support is a maintainer planning assumption; this update does not audit or certify those routes.

proposed_defaults.xlsx: Visible sheets in workbook order; hidden sheet/row/column exclusions disclosed; saved formula results only, missing/error cache refuses ingestion; no recalculation or external links.
proposed_defaults.pptx: Visible slides in deck order; native text/bullets/tables plus labeled speaker notes; hidden slide/shape exclusions disclosed; no visual/media interpretation.
proposed_defaults.shared: No partial/empty/diagnostic content success; known required-content loss refuses; no document --lines; one Tools converter, existing Memory chunking/storage unchanged.

current_source_observations: Chat admits PDF/DOCX/XLSX through placeholders and has no PPTX admission.
ReaderFactory selects PdfReader/DocxReader/XlsxReader, then other readers and binary fallback; no PPTX strategy.
SmartFileReadTool binary list includes PDF/DOCX/XLSX but not PPTX; it has no four-format shared conversion routing.
XlsxReader has active-sheet default, explicit sheet name/index, cell_range and data-row offset/limit contracts, plus a legacy XLSM route.

evidence_limit: Official format/backend inspection supports planning only. No selected Docling release, conversion execution, model readiness, dependency resolution or installed proof. Historical PDF/DOCX assessment remains unchanged.

required_dependency_floor.enforcement: declared dependency, lock and post-install semantic-version/origin proof
